qt_tests.counting: Primary total sums ui/workspace/integration only, including QtTest init/cleanup. Targeted run repeats selected cases and is supplemental.

findings_fixed: Moving datasets could leave the old canvas node selected while the source list switched trees, producing a disabled parameter editor or empty preview. Select the destination root and scroll it into view without changing zoom.

Undo/redo after a move could lose the selected task or choose a different input. Follow the existing dataset identity across history and preserve the moved input when the destination already contains other files.
Flush pending node edits before creating the move dialog so its revision and copied settings are current.
Outlier plots exposed internal port names in their legends. Use localized output names for original, processed and selected-outlier series.

fixtures.signal: Sine with one isolated positive spike per input

initial_acceptance: Set Y to the third column; batch application applies to two compatible files and skips the two-column file without changing its settings.
Edit one dataset threshold; switching inputs preserves independent values.
Keep a selected outlier on B; apply the node rule to all; A retains its own spike decision.
Run and save all three small inputs; inspect processed/original and outlier overlays.
post_fix_retest: Edit B threshold to 1.5 and immediately open Move; copy processing steps into a new tree.
Observe new root selected and scrolled into view, B selected in the source list, and copied threshold still 1.5.
Select copied child; Undo returns to original root and keeps B, Redo returns to destination root and keeps B.
Inspect Chinese legend: original series, selected outliers and processed series.
Move B into original tree containing A/C; observe B remains selected even though it is appended after the existing files.
Undo and Redo that existing-tree move; the data selection and canvas follow B.
Select destination processing node and observe its own threshold 3, matching the documented existing-tree rule.
Wait for preview completion and close the application normally.
native_desktop.timing_note: Native retest and 1000-case suite used final application-code fixes before the version-only/docs update. Final rebuilt binary is checked separately below.
native_desktop.limits: Linux observations do not establish Windows/MSVC or macOS native behavior or final package readiness.

supplemental_tests.scope: Two navigation/legend regressions and six embedded-help checks plus init/cleanup after final version and resource rebuild.

limits: No renewed large-data memory stress or Monte Carlo calibration.
No numerical algorithm, workflow schema or runtime dependency changes in this follow-up.
Windows/MSVC and macOS final source builds and distribution packages remain unverified.
